topic: How does the dual-mode operation of the CTS antenna impact frequency reuse and coverage patterns in Ka-band satellite architectures?
consensus_response: The dual-mode operation of CTS antennas enhances frequency reuse through polarization diversity, utilizing quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes for horizontal and vertical polarizations. This allows the same frequency to be reused, doubling capacity without additional bandwidth, while introducing complexities in interference management and beamforming.
reference_context: Dual-polarized CTS antennas enable efficient frequency reuse and coverage optimization in Ka-band multibeam satellite systems.
